group: Test readEscapeCharacter with valid escape sequences

cases.description: Test with escape sequence '\t' to ensure it returns the tab character.
Test with escape sequence '\b' to ensure it returns the backspace character.
Test with escape sequence '\n' to ensure it returns the newline character.
Test with escape sequence '\r' to ensure it returns the carriage return character.
Test with escape sequence '\f' to ensure it returns the form feed character.
Test with escape sequence '\'' to ensure it returns the single quote character.
Test with escape sequence '"' to ensure it returns the double quote character.
Test with escape sequence '\\' to ensure it returns the backslash character.
Test with escape sequence '\/' to ensure it returns the forward slash character.
Test with escape sequence '\u03A9' to ensure it returns the character 'Ω'.

group: Test readEscapeCharacter with invalid escape sequences

cases.description: Test with an invalid escape sequence to ensure it throws an IOException with the correct message.
Test with an unterminated escape sequence to ensure it throws an IOException with the correct message.
Test with an invalid unicode escape sequence to ensure it throws a NumberFormatException with the correct message.
Test when the buffer is empty and an escape character is expected, ensure it throws an IOException.

group: Test readEscapeCharacter with additional valid escape sequences

cases.description: Test with an escape sequence '\x01' to ensure it throws an IOException for an invalid escape sequence.
Test with an escape sequence '\xFF' to ensure it throws an IOException for an invalid escape sequence.

group: Test readEscapeCharacter with buffer edge cases

cases.description: Test when the buffer is partially filled with an escape sequence '\u' and ensure it throws an IOException.
Test when the buffer is filled with a single escape character '\' and ensure it throws an IOException.

group: Test readEscapeCharacter with different unicode escape scenarios

cases.description: Test with an invalid unicode escape sequence '\uG123' to ensure it throws a NumberFormatException.
Test with an incomplete unicode escape sequence '\u123' to ensure it throws a NumberFormatException.

group: Test readEscapeCharacter with additional invalid escape sequences

cases.description: Test with an escape sequence '\x01' to ensure it throws an IOException for an invalid escape sequence.
Test with an escape sequence '\xFF' to ensure it throws an IOException for an invalid escape sequence.
